title: Reel opening at Don Albert's home, January 1974
summary: Dick Allen identifies the reel, date and place of the interview at Albert's home.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: We got on our first new reel, complete reel, January the 1st, the home of Don Albert, 715 St. James, 1974, did I say that? I probably said 1973.
Well, we sure in 1974, that's for sure.
Yeah, and Dick Allen still talking to Dono. And we're looking at this letter from William G.
